dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (likely compiled with cobc); Italian-language business application using COMP-1 for NARG, C$NARG intrinsic, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, and Italian text throughout. Possibly targeting a Linux/Windows environment with file-based indexed files.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian wholesale/distribution: logs articles with stock level 4 (scorta 4), checks committed quantities (impegnato GDO/TRAD), and exports open master orders to a CSV file for analysis.
purpose.summary: This batch program (log4mas) scans an articles file for items at stock level 4, checks their committed quantities in a warehouse master file, then iterates open customer orders (mrordini/mtordini) to produce a CSV report and a log file. It handles file locking via a 'geslock' subprogram and supports both scheduled and interactive invocation.

notable_features: DECLARATIVES section with USE AFTER ERROR for file error handling
Italian-language variable names and display messages
CSV file generation with configurable separator
STRING with LOW-VALUE delimiter for path construction
ACCEPT from ENVIRONMENT for runtime configuration
geslock subprogram for file locking with retry/ignore/terminate logic
verdict.notes: The program is entirely in Italian and targets an Italian retail/distribution domain. The use of C$NARG and COMP-1 for nargs strongly suggests GnuCOBOL. The copybook-heavy structure (.sl for SELECT, .fd for FD, .def for working-storage) is consistent with a modular production codebase. No ENVIRONMENT DIVISION header is present (only FILE-CONTROL under INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION), which is slightly unusual but valid. Max line length is exactly 72, confirming fixed format.
